<section class="page-intro">
  <p class="section-kicker">About</p>
  <h1>Bioinformatics, computational biology, and medical AI for precision medicine.</h1>
  <p class="lead">Hao Huang is an Associate Research Fellow and PhD Supervisor at Southeast University. His research focuses on bioinformatics, computational biology, and medical artificial intelligence.</p>
  <p>His work combines multi-omics data analysis, regulatory genomics, and computational modeling to study cancer heterogeneity, super-enhancer biology, biomarker discovery, and translational problems in precision medicine. He received his PhD in Bioinformatics from City University of Hong Kong, with joint training experience involving Cornell University, and previously completed his master's and bachelor's training at Harbin Medical University.</p>
</section>

    <article class="feature-card">
      <h3>Cancer regulatory genomics</h3>
      <p>Studying super-enhancers, transcriptional drivers, and regulatory heterogeneity in cancers such as triple-negative breast cancer.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="feature-card">
      <h3>Precision medicine computation</h3>
      <p>Developing computational strategies for biomarker discovery, neoantigen analysis, and clinically relevant multi-omics interpretation.</p>
    </article>
    <article class="feature-card">
      <h3>Biomedical AI and data integration</h3>
      <p>Combining machine learning and biological knowledge to build more informative models for complex biomedical systems.</p>
    </article>
